pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'le garçon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandmother
   B. the child
   C. the grandfather
   D. the boy

2. How do you say 'It is a table.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   B. C'est une table.
   C. Le livre est sur la table.
   D. Où est le chat ?

3. How do you say 'Today it is Monday.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   B. Le samedi, je joue.
   C. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   D. Une semaine, sept jours.

4. How do you say 'A week, seven days.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le samedi, je joue.
   B. Une semaine, sept jours.
   C. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   D. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.

5. What does 'le poisson' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fish
   B. the banana
   C. juice
   D. the carrot

6. What does 'la bouche' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the knee
   B. the head
   C. the hand
   D. the mouth

7. How do you say 'She has long hair.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux mains.
   B. Elle est petite.
   C. J'ai deux oreilles.
   D. Elle a les cheveux longs.

8. How do you say 'He is tall.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai un nez.
   B. Touche ton nez !
   C. Il est grand.
   D. J'ai deux pieds.

9. How do you say 'Today it is raining.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Demain, il fait beau.
   B. Je reste dans la maison.
   C. Il y a du vent.
   D. Aujourd'hui, il pleut.

10. What does 'la clé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the shop
   B. the garden
   C. the rug
   D. the key

11. How do you say 'You are welcome!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. La télé est sur la table.
   B. Tournez à droite.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. De rien !

12. What does 'Allez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Turn
   B. You are welcome
   C. Go
   D. Excuse me

13. What does 'C'est le bébé.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is my grandfather.
   B. This is my father.
   C. It is the baby.
   D. This is my brother.

14. Which little word goes with 'père' (the father)? (1 mark)
   A. l'
   B. les
   C. la
   D. le

15. Which little word goes with 'mère' (the mother)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. le

16. What does 'La télé est dans le salon.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where is the cat?
   B. The book is on the table.
   C. The TV is in the living room.
   D. It is a table.

17. What does 'Où est le chat ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Put the book on the table.
   B. The TV is in the living room.
   C. The ball is behind the door.
   D. Where is the cat?

18. What does 'Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The cat is under the chair.
   B. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   C. Put the book on the table.
   D. The rug is in front of the sofa.

19. Which little word goes with 'cadeau' (the a present)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. les
   C. la
   D. l'

20. What does 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Happy birthday!
   B. There is a cake and there are balloons.
   C. I sing and I dance.
   D. My birthday is on 30 June.

21. What does 'Voici un cadeau pour toi.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Here is a present for you.
   B. My birthday is on 12 May.
   C. I am nine years old.
   D. Happy birthday!

22. What does 'Ce sont des mangues.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. They are mangoes.
   B. At midday, I eat rice and beans.
   C. I like milk.
   D. In the morning, I eat bread.

23. What does 'C'est une banane.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. I drink a juice.
   C. It is a banana.
   D. What is it?

24. How do you say 'the table' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la table
   B. la salle de bain
   C. la télé
   D. la cuisine

25. Fill in: C'est ______ table. (1 mark)
   A. une
   B. un
   C. le
   D. des

26. How do you write the number 7 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix
   B. dix-huit
   C. treize
   D. sept

27. How do you say the month 'July' in French? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. novembre
   C. juillet
   D. février

28. How do you say the month 'June' in French? (1 mark)
   A. octobre
   B. juin
   C. décembre
   D. mars

29. How do you say 'the neck' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les yeux
   B. la tête
   C. le ventre
   D. le cou

30. How do you say 'It is cold.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il fait froid.
   B. Il fait chaud.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. Il fait beau.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je me repose.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'What day is it today?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: 'C'est une banane.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'J'ai deux yeux.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'They are oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Explain why it is important to store things safely at home. Give two examples. (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'I eat a mango.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into French: 'Here is my grandmother.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into English: 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into French: 'It is snowing.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'Who is it?' (2 marks) (2 marks)

43. Explain why the order le 12 mai matters and write the date the wrong way for comparison. (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'On Saturday, I help my mother.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Je chante et je danse.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'When is your birthday?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'My mother is called Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into French: 'The rug is under the table.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #17 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A
----
1. D — the boy
   le garçon means the boy.

2. B — C'est une table.
   It is a table. in French is C'est une table.

3. A — Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   Today it is Monday. in French is Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.

4. B — Une semaine, sept jours.
   A week, seven days. in French is Une semaine, sept jours.

5. A — fish
   le poisson means fish.

6. D — the mouth
   la bouche means the mouth.

7. D — Elle a les cheveux longs.
   She has long hair. in French is Elle a les cheveux longs.

8. C — Il est grand.
   He is tall. in French is Il est grand.

9. D — Aujourd'hui, il pleut.
   Today it is raining. in French is Aujourd'hui, il pleut.

10. D — the key
   la clé means the key.

11. D — De rien !
   You are welcome! in French is De rien !

12. C — Go
   Allez means Go.

13. C — It is the baby.
   C'est le bébé. means It is the baby.

14. D — le
   père is masculine, so we say le père.

15. A — la
   mère is feminine, so we say la mère.

16. C — The TV is in the living room.
   La télé est dans le salon. means The TV is in the living room.

17. D — Where is the cat?

18. B — In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo. means In the kitchen, there is a fridge.

19. A — le
   cadeau is masculine, so we say le cadeau.

20. D — My birthday is on 30 June.
   Mon anniversaire, c'est le 30 juin. means My birthday is on 30 June.

21. A — Here is a present for you.
   Voici un cadeau pour toi. means Here is a present for you.

22. A — They are mangoes.
   Ce sont des mangues. means They are mangoes.

23. C — It is a banana.
   C'est une banane. means It is a banana.

24. A — la table
   the table in French is la table.

25. A — une
   Table is feminine, so une.

26. D — sept
   7 in French is sept.

27. C — juillet
   July in French is juillet.

28. B — juin
   June in French is juin.

29. D — le cou
   the neck in French is le cou.

30. A — Il fait froid.
   It is cold. in French is Il fait froid..
